from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List

class Reference(BaseModel):
    """A paper referenced by this paper (from the provided collection)."""
    title: str = Field(description="Title of the referenced paper from the collection")

class CitingPaper(BaseModel):
    """A paper that cites this paper (from the provided collection)."""
    title: str = Field(description="Title of the citing paper from the collection")

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single provided paper with its citation relationships within the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    references: List[Reference] = Field(description="Other provided papers that this paper references/cites")
    citations: List[CitingPaper] = Field(description="Other provided papers that cite this paper")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: List[Paper]
